# Experiment Outputs

## Generated by controller.py
- **experiments.jsonl** — Append-only ledger of all cycles
  - Per cycle: hypothesis, source_technique, predicted_effect, code_diff, metrics, tokens, gpu_seconds
  - Example: `{"cycle": 1, "hypothesis": "...", "metrics": {"ndcg@10": 0.8144}, ...}`
  
- **INSIGHTS.md** — Lessons from successful iterations
  - Example: "BPR successfully optimized pairwise preferences"
  
- **DEAD_ENDS.md** — Why ideas failed
  - Example: "LambdaMART: insufficient training data"

## For Judges
- Ledger proves autonomy (zero interventions)
- Ledger proves learning (keeps good ideas, rejects bad ones)
- Journals prove transparency (why each decision was made)
- Metrics & tokens prove efficiency
